messages.text: Do you plan to sell the new Nexus S1-8? Would buy it from you all if you could add the Harlo O/S.

The 8 TH/s Nexus we carry is the NEXUS QX1, $248, four BM1370 chips, ~170 W, under 50 dB, PSU in the box. It's live now: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/nexus-qx1-8th-s

Whether Harlo OS can run on it, I won't guess. That's a firmware call, and I've passed it to Georges. The team is offline right now, they pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.

Would Harlo OS be the dealbreaker, or the dashboard specifically?
